items.title: U.S. government warns of ‘ongoing cyber threat’ amid mass-hacks of industrial retail and military freezers
items.summary: A joint U.S. government statement says the hacks are affecting the food, transportation, and healthcare industries after reports of global mass-hacks.

items.title: OpenAI president Greg Brockman says company could be IPO ready in 2027
items.summary: OpenAI president Greg Brockman says the company could be ready to go public in 2027, pointing to accelerating enterprise revenue and a turnaround in its business.

items.title: The ex-Secret Service agent who flipped a hacker is now raising a second $250M cybersecurity fund
items.summary: Stephen Ward, a former Secret Service agent and Home Depot CISO, is preparing a second fund of roughly $250 million for Brightmind Partners.
